description: The second JASDF T-6; the first of the series survives only as a forward fuselage at an airsoft field in Toyokawa
Repainted between January and March 2021; the contract paperwork classes it as a display aircraft
Early F-86F-30 with wing fences carrying the yellow and black checks of 1 Sqn at Hamamatsu
Classed in the base paperwork as a converted airframe for fire-fighting training rather than a display aircraft; repainted early 2021
Serial 91-4707 but repainted as 91-4777 by 2000 and left that way; repainted again early 2021 and formally classed as a display aircraft
Replaced the first T-1 built which had deteriorated
surface_to_air Training round in the display group at 33.8892N 130.6636E; a second Nike-J stands west of the control tower at 33.8795N 130.6479E
Fin only inside the base reference hall
Eight-tenths scale model in the base reference hall
Forward fuselage of the aircraft written off in the accident of 5 Apr 1967; the nose is heavily crushed back to the gun panels
